title: A Thorn for the Veil
premise: Xanthe Oyelaran was exiled to the Veiled Valley as a child, a storm-caller whose magic the valley's wards suppress — until the night the stars go out and the wards collapse, dragging them into a war between realms they were exiled to prevent. Guided by Serah Vane, a knight of the fallen border order sworn to truths she once buried, Xanthe must reforge the Oathstone covenant that binds sky-magic to earth before the starless dark devours both realms. Betrayal, buried memory, and a love neither can afford force Xanthe to choose between restoring their stolen power and saving the world that exiled them. In the end, Xanthe shatters the Oathstone rather than reforge it, releasing magic equally to all realms at the cost of their own memories of the valley — and of Serah.
about_author: Emrys Coldharbour is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping coastlines before turning to map impossible ones. They write fantasy about borders — geographic, magical, and emotional — from a rain-soaked study full of obsolete atlases.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. On the eve of the valley's Founding Festival, every star vanishes at once, and the ancient wards that have caged the valley for twenty years shatter like glass. Xanthe feels their suppressed storm-magic stir for the first time. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread as the familiar world ends in a single breathless night.

chapters.title: What the Wards Were Hiding
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. A wounded knight of the collapsed Border Order staggers into the valley's market square, pursued by creatures made of unlight. She recognizes Xanthe's surname from sealed records and demands their help. Emotional beat: reluctant collision — two people bound by secrets neither fully understands yet.

chapters.title: Exile, Remembered
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Fleeing the first wave of the dark, Xanthe recalls fragments of the night they were carried across the border as a child — fragments that don't match the exile story they were told. Emotional beat: grief and disorientation as home becomes a question instead of an answer.

chapters.title: The Road Beyond the Veil
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The pair crosses the dead borderlands toward the ruined citadel of Vaelmoor, where the Oathstone covenant was once forged. Serah teaches Xanthe what the covenant was — and lies about her own role in its breaking. Emotional beat: wary trust built on uneven ground.

chapters.title: Creatures of Unlight
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. An ambush by hollow-born reveals they hunt Xanthe specifically, drawn to their dormant storm-caller blood. In desperation, Xanthe's magic sparks free for three devastating seconds. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration entwined — power as both salvation and threat.

chapters.title: The Order That Failed
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. At a refugee camp of scattered Border Order survivors, Serah faces her old commander, who knows why the wards truly fell — and why Serah was stationed near the valley all these years. Emotional beat: shame sharpened into resolve; Serah chooses to keep her secret a little longer.

chapters.title: Vaelmoor's Broken Heart
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. They reach the shattered citadel and find the Oathstone split in two, one half missing. Within its fracture, Xanthe hears voices — memories stored in the stone itself, including one that speaks with their mother's cadence. Emotional beat: awe giving way to personal stakes; this is family business, not just prophecy.

chapters.title: The Half That Walks
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The missing half of the Oathstone was carried north by Serah's former mentor, Aldric Vey, now something more than human after decades bonded to it. Serah confesses part of her past: she was sent to watch the valley, not protect it. Emotional beat: confession without absolution.

chapters.title: Storms Without Permission
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Training to wield their magic deliberately, Xanthe discovers each use erases a small memory — the price the covenant exacted from all storm-callers. They begin hiding the cost from Serah. Emotional beat: intimacy deepening alongside deception; love and secrecy growing from the same root.

chapters.title: The Court of Ash and Salt
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Seeking allies, they petition the coastal realm of Serevan, whose queen offers aid at a brutal price: the storm-caller's allegiance, binding Xanthe to a new master. Emotional beat: political humiliation; Xanthe realizes freedom was always someone else's transaction.

chapters.title: Aldric Vey, Half a God
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Confrontation with Aldric in a drowned cathedral. He offers Xanthe the missing Oathstone half freely — if Xanthe will reforge the covenant as written, restoring the old hierarchy that exiled them. Emotional beat: temptation framed as justice; the enemy who sounds most like an ally.

chapters.title: What Serah Buried
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Flashback chapter: twenty years ago, young Serah helped carry a screaming child across the border and helped forge the lie of exile, believing she was saving the realms. Present-day Serah finally tells Xanthe everything. Emotional beat: the truth as a wound that finally stops festering once opened.

chapters.title: Rage Like Weather
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Betrayed and grieving, Xanthe unleashes a true storm — and loses a year of memories to it, including, unknowingly, parts of their days with Serah. Emotional beat: fury and heartbreak rendered as literal weather; love damaged by the very power meant to protect it.

chapters.title: The Starless March
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The unlight begins consuming the land itself, and refugees from all realms converge on Vaelmoor. Serah organizes a defense while watching Xanthe look at her with polite unfamiliarity. Emotional beat: devotion without reciprocity; loving someone who has forgotten you.

chapters.title: The Covenant's True Text
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Reading the original covenant within the Oathstone's memory-voices, Xanthe learns it was never about sealing magic away — it was a treaty of shared burden, rewritten by the founders into a cage. Reforging it as written would restore the lie. Emotional beat: revelation reframing the entire quest; the goal itself was corrupt.

chapters.title: Queen's Gambit
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Serevan's army arrives to enforce the queen's claim on Xanthe. Serah publicly breaks her knighthood to stand between them, declaring the old orders void. Emotional beat: sacrifice as declaration; duty redirected rather than abandoned.

chapters.title: Two Halves, One Choice
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. With both Oathstone halves united, Xanthe stands at the reforging altar as the starless dark closes in. Aldric offers final counsel; the memory-voices offer another path entirely — break the stone, and let magic belong to no covenant at all. Emotional beat: the still point of decision; destiny held in two hands.

chapters.title: The Breaking of the Stone
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Climax. Xanthe shatters the Oathstone, releasing magic to all realms equally — and paying the full price: every memory of the valley, of exile, of Serah. The starless dark, starved of its stolen covenant, dissolves. Emotional beat: triumph inseparable from loss; victory paid in selfhood.

chapters.title: Stars, Returning
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Dawn comes and stars return. Serah finds Xanthe alive but a stranger to her, and chooses not to impose the past upon them — only to walk beside them anyway. Emotional beat: quiet devastation and stubborn hope; love offered without claim.

chapters.title: The Valley Without Walls
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The valley opens its borders. Xanthe, memory-less but instinct-drawn, returns to where they grew up and feels nothing — then meets Serah on the road and feels something inexplicable. Emotional beat: bittersweet new beginning; identity rebuilt from choice rather than history.

chapters.title: A New Covenant
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Realms gather at ruined Vaelmoor to write a covenant honestly this time, with Xanthe and Serah among its architects. Old powers resist; the pair's partnership becomes the argument's living proof. Emotional beat: hard-won hope; the future drafted by those it will bind.

chapters.title: What Remains When Memory Ends
chapters.summary: Dual POV, closing chapter. On the festival eve one year later, under returned stars, Xanthe tells Serah they've begun dreaming fragments — a market square, a laugh, a hand in theirs. Whether memory returns or not, they choose to stay. Emotional beat: love against duty resolved into love beyond memory; an ending that is also a threshold.
